methodology.previousEvidence: Existing wordfirst-02 and timing-core-01 native reports tested A only; they are preserved and not reused as validation of this B profile
methodology.procedure: Fresh ready StrategyWorker for each case; startup excluded from evaluation timer. Unmodified native arm first, then isolated instrumented production-engine child. No concurrent evaluations, no live connection.
methodology.statesScope: Actual production decision exposes only current cashout exactness, not DP states. Native optimizerStates is explicitly null. Separate child captures the original optimizer returns/states and phase durations; never substitute those for native results.
methodology.instrumentation: Wrap original optimize/playable/completion methods. Time entries.sort and the first/second available-entry iterations (greedy/grouping) without adding searches. Iterator/method overhead can affect deadline-adjacent results.
methodology.boundaries: Active N2 rack maximum92 before final closure, final-held maximum93; active N6 maximum72, final-held73. Cases93/98 are labelled boundary-only and never pretend to submit post-game words. All counts respect DEFAULT_BAG.

summary.timingAcceptanceGate: None; observed timeouts/overruns are retained diagnostic outcomes, not automatic promotion/rejection
